'''Tereez Tey'flah''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] and member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] cell on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] led by [[Card Captor]].<ref name="Cloud Cover" /> 

She worked with [[Garul]] in the attempt to rescue the families of several Alliance members<ref name="Cloud Cover" />
